reason: I already have one workshop I have trusted for years, and I like negotiating the price with them face to face. An app that is only just adding its first partners in Riyadh and Cairo does not give me a reason to switch for a paint film job on the M4.
objection: I do not know who these partners really are or whether the one who quotes is the one who does the work. And if I have to wait hours or days for quotes when I want a price now, I will just call my workshop.
would_change_my_mind: If my own workshop charged clearly more than the app quotes for the same film, and I could see a named partner in my city with a track record of work I could check myself.
